Just to clarify things a bit, you do not have to play with the No
Repeat Actions Rule, but most people do. They usually realize it is
good to play with when a vampire with superior presence taps all of
their blockers using bleed to draw the block and Magesty at superior
to untap. It is highly annoying. This is the common occurence. Then
you have the Stanislava Infinite Bleed Loop Deck that will usually
oust 2 players in a single turn with just one vampire. This broke the
game and instituted the NRA rules for tournaments.
